purpose: Record the native CyaSSL certificate-date path recovered from clean IDA decompilation.

database.tooling: IDA 9.3 IDALIB with Hex-Rays decompiler, clean user profile

functions.name: CyaInt_ValidateDate_uchar_const_uchar_int
functions.behavior: Parses UTCTime tag 23 or GeneralizedTime tag 24 and compares the resulting UTC timestamp with time(nullptr) through gmtime().
functions.mode_zero: Accepts a certificate time at or before the current UTC time.
functions.mode_one: Accepts a certificate time at or after the current UTC time.

functions.name: CyaInt_DecodeToKey_CyaInt_DecodedCert_int
functions.behavior: Parses the certificate public-key area and then validates the two X.509 validity fields.

functions.name: CyaInt_ParseCertRelative_CyaInt_DecodedCert_int_int_void
functions.behavior: Calls CyaInt_DecodeToKey with its certificate-validation flag and continues parsing the certificate body and signature material.

functions.name: CyaInt_CyaSSL_CertManagerVerifyBuffer_CyaInt_CYASSL_CERT_MANAGER_uchar_const_long_int
functions.behavior: Initializes a decoded certificate from the supplied PEM or DER trust buffer, parses it through CyaInt_ParseCertRelative, frees temporary state, and returns the parser result.

functions.name: CyaInt_ProcessReply_CyaInt_CYASSL
functions.behavior: Processes the TLS handshake records. Certificate message type 11 calls the certificate-chain helper at 0x2ca940, which reaches CyaInt_ParseCertRelative and therefore the date checks when verification is enabled.

functions.name: CyaInt_CyaSSL_connect_CyaInt_CYASSL
functions.behavior: Runs the CyaSSL client handshake and dispatches received records through CyaInt_ProcessReply.

validity_mapping.strict_flag: The parser passes a nonzero strict flag when certificate verification is active. In that mode the notAfter failure is retained as -151.

runtime_correlation.interpretation: The static date logic explains the paired local result in which the SAN-matching expired certificate closed during TLS while the matching valid certificate reached GET /con.png.

limitations: The decompiler names are evidence-backed aliases, not a recovered CyaSSL source release.
The exact error value observed by a physical ARM64 device was not instrumented.
The test used a generated local certificate and did not contact a live service.
